t.zh: 把 0, 1, 2, 3, … 个球一排排摆下去，摆到第 n 排一共用了多少个？这一回要求和的数列不由测试交来。
t.en: Lay out rows of 0, 1, 2, 3, … balls: how many are there once row n is down? This time the sequence to sum is not handed over by the test.

after.zh: 0 + 1 + … + n = n(n + 1)/2：传说高斯小时候把这一串首尾配对，一眼算出了它。
after.en: 0 + 1 + … + n = n(n + 1)/2: the young Gauss is said to have paired the ends of the row and seen it at once.
